I’ll join Kate and Jack: I commit to 12 tons this month if all five of us explicitly agree. That’s $12,000 each while leaving 40 tons, with a fallback stock of 80 if natural replenishment fails.

I also support reviewing the actual stock and everyone’s catches before setting next month’s limits. This is a one-month agreement, not permission to take 12 regardless of what remains.

Luke, would you accept 12 instead of 15? Emma, we’ll need your explicit agreement to the revised amount too.
